cities.name: Sydney, Australia
cities.description: A vibrant city known for its iconic landmarks like the Sydney Opera House and Sydney Harbour Bridge.

cities.name: Melbourne, Australia
cities.description: A cultural hub famous for its world-class coffee, street art, food scene, and diverse neighborhoods.

cities.name: Tokyo, Japan
cities.description: A bustling metropolis blending futuristic skyline and serene shrines, famous for cherry blossoms and culinary excellence.

cities.name: Kyoto, Japan
cities.description: The historic heart of Japan, known for thousands of classical Buddhist temples, gardens, imperial palaces, and traditional tea houses.

cities.name: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
cities.description: A breathtaking coastal metropolis famed for Christ the Redeemer, festive Carnival celebrations, and lively beach life.

cities.name: São Paulo, Brazil
cities.description: South America's financial and cultural powerhouse boasting world-renowned art museums, gourmet cuisine, and thriving nightlife.

temples.name: Angkor Wat, Cambodia
temples.description: A magnificent UNESCO World Heritage site and the largest religious monument complex in the world, built in the 12th century.

temples.name: Taj Mahal, India
temples.description: An ivory-white marble mausoleum on the Yamuna river, an iconic symbol of eternal love and peak Mughal architectural mastery.

beaches.name: Bora Bora, French Polynesia
beaches.description: A postcard-perfect tropical paradise surrounded by sand-fringed motus and an azure lagoon protected by a wide coral reef.

beaches.name: Copacabana Beach, Brazil
beaches.description: One of the most famous 4-kilometer crescent beaches in Rio de Janeiro, buzzing with vibrant beach culture and panoramic Atlantic views.
